title: UI diff
description: How close recording b is to recording a, two ui-recordings of the same steps file, and what differs in each state.

a.description: Absolute path of the reference recording.json.

b.description: Absolute path of the recording.json judged against a.

tolerance.description: Largest per-channel difference that still counts as the same pixel.

score.description: The mean of the state scores. 1 means identical.

states.description: a's states in order, then states only b has. States pair by name.

missing.description: The recording that lacks this state. A missing state scores 0.

size.description: Settled screenshot size in CSS pixels, [width, height], including ui-record's margin. Null for a missing side.

pixels.description: The settled screenshots compared on their overlap after top-left alignment. Null for a missing state.

mismatch.description: Fraction of overlap pixels whose largest channel difference exceeds tolerance.

meanDelta.description: Mean of the largest channel difference over the overlap, in levels from 0 to 255.

mismatch.description: Null when only one recording has this frame.

styles.description: Computed properties that differ after normalizing, on element paths both recordings have, grouped by property and the two values. Groups follow their first path, root first.

count.description: How many elements differ this way.

paths.description: The first element paths that differ this way, root first.

animations.description: Animations on the same element path, paired by equal keyframes first and then by the same animated properties, never by name.

a.description: a's value. For keyframes, each keyframe's offset and normalized property values, without timing.

motion.description: ui-record's computed transform and opacity tracks that differ, root first. Only an element whose value changed across the frames has a track.

frame.description: The frame where the tracks are furthest apart. Null when only one recording moves the element.

a.description: The value at every frame, or null when the element holds still in a.

image.description: A PNG of a, b, and a heatmap side by side. Null for a missing state.

sheet.description: A contact sheet of the frames both recordings have, one column per frame index, with a, b, and the heatmap stacked top to bottom. Null when no frame index is shared.

target.description: Element path, with the pseudo-element appended when there is one.

properties.description: The properties its keyframes animate, sorted.

easing.description: The animation's easing, or the keyframes' shared easing when the animation's own reads linear.
